content.query:
let month_start = startofmonth(now());
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated >= month_start and Name == "chat_turn"
| extend country = tostring(Properties["country"]),
         cost_usd = todouble(Properties["cost_usd"])
| summarize spend_usd = sum(cost_usd) by country
| order by country asc
content.title: Spend this month by country (USD)

content.query:
let from_time = {TimeRange:start};
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated >= from_time and Name == "chat_turn"
| extend country = tostring(Properties["country"]),
         conversation_id = tostring(Properties["conversation_id"]),
         outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"]),
         cost_usd = todouble(Properties["cost_usd"])
| summarize cost_usd = sum(cost_usd),
            answered = countif(outcome == "answered"),
            failed = countif(outcome == "model_error")
          by country, conversation_id
| where answered > 0 and failed == 0
| summarize resolved_conversations = count(),
            total_cost_usd = sum(cost_usd),
            cost_per_resolved_conversation_usd = sum(cost_usd) / count()
          by country
| order by country asc
content.title: Cost per resolved conversation

content.query:
let from_time = {TimeRange:start};
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated >= from_time and Name == "chat_turn"
| extend country = tostring(Properties["country"]),
         model = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.request.model"]),
         input_tokens = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
         output_tokens = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| summarize turns = count(),
            input_tokens = sum(input_tokens),
            output_tokens = sum(output_tokens)
          by country, app = AppRoleName, model
| extend total_tokens = input_tokens + output_tokens
| order by total_tokens desc
content.title: Tokens by country, app and model

content.query:
let from_time = {TimeRange:start};
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated >= from_time and Name == "chat_turn"
| extend country = tostring(Properties["country"]),
         cache_hit = tostring(Properties["cache_hit"]) == "True"
| summarize turns = count(), cache_hits = countif(cache_hit) by country
| extend cache_hit_rate = todouble(cache_hits) / turns
| order by country asc
content.title: Cache hit rate

content.query:
let from_time = {TimeRange:start};
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated >= from_time and Name == "chat_turn"
| extend country = tostring(Properties["country"]),
         tier = tostring(Properties["route_tier"])
| summarize turns = count(),
            p50_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 50),
            p95_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95)
          by country, tier
| order by country asc, tier asc
content.title: Latency p50 and p95 by country and tier

content.query:
let from_time = {TimeRange:start};
let gateway = AppRequests
    | where TimeGenerated >= from_time and AppRoleName contains "apim"
    | extend country = tostring(Properties["country"])
    | summarize gateway_requests = count(), gateway_429 = countif(ResultCode == "429")
      by country;
let turns = AppDependencies
    | where TimeGenerated >= from_time and Name == "chat_turn"
    | extend country = tostring(Properties["country"]),
             fallback_used = tostring(Properties["fallback_used"]) == "True"
    | summarize turns = count(), fallbacks = countif(fallback_used) by country;
turns
| join kind=fullouter gateway on country
| project country = coalesce(country, country1), turns, fallbacks,
          fallback_rate = iff(turns > 0, todouble(fallbacks) / turns, real(null)),
          gateway_requests, gateway_429,
          rate_429 = iff(gateway_requests > 0, todouble(gateway_429) / gateway_requests, real(null))
| order by country asc
content.title: 429s at the gateway and fallbacks in the app

content.query:
let from_time = {TimeRange:start};
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated >= from_time and Name == "eval_summary"
| extend language = tostring(Properties["language"]),
         model = tostring(Properties["model"]),
         groundedness = todouble(Properties["groundedness"]),
         relevance = todouble(Properties["relevance"])
| summarize groundedness = avg(groundedness), relevance = avg(relevance)
          by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), language, model
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Groundedness and relevance by language
